enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Unholy 3: On Hit: 3 to 18 Evil damage. Evil-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Good user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Crushing 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to ripple with force, dealing 7d6 force damage on each critical hit.
Disintegrate 2: Strikes with this weapon have a small chance to call forth a strike of entropic force, dealing 2d20+27 untyped damage.
Vampirism 1: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +1d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
